title.en: Tale 16 — The Gazelle in the Trap

sentences.ar: بيوم، راحت الغزالة ترعى زي كل يوم، وما رجعت.
sentences.en: One day, the gazelle went to graze as she did every day, and did not return.

sentences.ar: غابت الشمس، وهي لسا مش هون.
sentences.en: The sun set, and she still was not there.

sentences.ar: قالت السلحفاة: الغزالة ما بتتأخر.
sentences.en: The tortoise said: the gazelle is never late.

sentences.ar: صار لها إشي.
sentences.en: Something has happened to her.

sentences.ar: قال الغراب: أنا بطير وبدور عليها من فوق.
sentences.en: The crow said: I will fly and look for her from above.

sentences.ar: وطار فوق الغابة، يدور ويدور.
sentences.en: And he flew over the forest, searching and searching.

sentences.ar: لقاها بالآخر، جنب الطريق، واقعة بفخ صياد.
sentences.en: He found her at last, beside the road, caught in a hunter's trap.

sentences.ar: الحبل ملفوف على إجرها، وهي ما بتقدر تتحرك.
sentences.en: The rope was wound around her leg, and she could not move.

sentences.ar: قالت: يا غراب، روح، الصياد رح يرجع الصبح.
sentences.en: She said: crow, go, the hunter will return in the morning.

sentences.ar: قال الغراب: بروح، بس برجع.
sentences.en: The crow said: I will go, but I will come back.

sentences.ar: طار للغدير، وحمل الفار على ظهره، ورجع.
sentences.en: He flew to the pond, carried the mouse on his back, and returned.

sentences.ar: والفار بلش يقص الحبل بأسنانه، حبل ورا حبل.
sentences.en: And the mouse began cutting the rope with his teeth, strand after strand.

sentences.ar: بس السلحفاة ما قدرت تقعد لحالها.
sentences.en: But the tortoise could not stay by herself.

sentences.ar: قالت: صاحبتي بخطر وأنا قاعدة؟
sentences.en: She said: my friend is in danger and I sit?

sentences.ar: وإجت مشي، على مهلها، لأنها بطيئة.
sentences.en: And she came on foot, slowly, because she is slow.

sentences.ar: لما وصلت، كان الفار خلص الحبل، والغزالة صارت حرة.
sentences.en: When she arrived, the mouse had finished the rope, and the gazelle was free.

sentences.ar: قال الغراب: يا سلحفاة، ليش جيتي؟
sentences.en: The crow said: tortoise, why did you come?

sentences.ar: إنتي ما بتقدري تهربي!
sentences.en: You cannot run!

sentences.ar: وبنفس اللحظة، بان الصياد من بعيد.
sentences.en: And in that same moment, the hunter appeared from afar.

sentences.ar: الغزالة ركضت، والفار فات بجحر، والغراب طار.
sentences.en: The gazelle ran, the mouse went into a hole, and the crow flew up.

sentences.ar: بس السلحفاة ضلت مكانها.
sentences.en: But the tortoise stayed where she was.

sentences.ar: الصياد لقى الفخ فاضي، وزعل، وبعدين شاف السلحفاة.
sentences.en: The hunter found the trap empty, was angry, and then saw the tortoise.

sentences.ar: قال: ولا إشي أحسن من ولا إشي.
sentences.en: He said: nothing is better than nothing.

sentences.ar: ربطها بحبل وحطها بكيس، ومشى.
sentences.en: He tied her with a rope, put her in a sack, and walked on.

sentences.ar: الأصحاب التلاتة شافوا اللي صار من بعيد.
sentences.en: The three friends saw what happened from afar.

sentences.ar: قال الغراب: إحنا التلاتة نجونا، والرابعة انمسكت.
sentences.en: The crow said: the three of us are saved, and the fourth is caught.

sentences.ar: لازم نرجعها.
sentences.en: We must get her back.

sentences.ar: عملوا خطة.
sentences.en: They made a plan.

sentences.ar: الغزالة راحت ووقفت قدام الصياد بالطريق، وعملت حالها عرجا.
sentences.en: The gazelle went and stood in front of the hunter on the road, and pretended to be lame.

sentences.ar: والغراب وقف على ظهرها، زي إنه بينقرها، زي إنها ميتة.
sentences.en: And the crow perched on her back, as if pecking at her, as if she were dead.

sentences.ar: قال الصياد: غزالة عرجا!
sentences.en: The hunter said: a lame gazelle!

sentences.ar: هاي أحسن من سلحفاة.
sentences.en: This is better than a tortoise.

sentences.ar: حط الكيس عالأرض وركض وراها.
sentences.en: He put the sack on the ground and ran after her.

sentences.ar: وكل ما يقرب، تبعد الغزالة شوي، وكل ما يقرب، تبعد شوي.
sentences.en: And each time he came near, the gazelle moved a little away, and each time he came near, a little away.

sentences.ar: وبهالوقت، الفار قص حبل الكيس، وطلعت السلحفاة.
sentences.en: And in that time, the mouse cut the rope of the sack, and the tortoise came out.

sentences.ar: لما رجع الصياد بلا غزالة، لقى الكيس فاضي كمان.
sentences.en: When the hunter came back without the gazelle, he found the sack empty too.

sentences.ar: قال بيدبا: اللي عندهم أصحاب ما بيضيعوا.
sentences.en: Bidpai said: those who have friends are not lost.
